subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge.

hook.text: This crossing is 34 miles long across open sea. It includes bridges, artificial islands, and a tunnel.

buildup.text: It connects Hong Kong, Macau, and Zhuhai across the Pearl River Delta in southern China.

discovery.text: The mid-section is a 4-mile immersed tunnel so that ships can pass over the crossing unimpeded.

twist.text: Traffic has been lower than expected. Complicated border controls limit who can drive across.

climax.text: At $20 billion, it's an engineering marvel that still searches for its full economic justification.

punchline.text: An incredible bridge. An uncertain business case.

quiz.question: Why does the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau crossing include a tunnel section?
options: So ships can pass over the crossing at that point
